battle.name: 突厥內戰
battle.brief: 開皇元年（581）起，漠北汗位繼承失序，沙摩羅弒佗斤自立，達摩可汗、達頭可汗、顛頡可汗相繼爭位，內戰延燒到開皇八年（588）。此役全無攻城，卡面那具羅馬投石機不在漠北，它標示的是同一時代另一種戰爭的尺度。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場戰爭沒有兩軍對壘的正面，只有同一個汗系內部的分裂與兼併，交戰方全在突厥一邊。開皇元年（581），沙摩羅可汗殺死幼主佗斤，自立為汗，把漠北聯盟握成一條鞭；同一時候，佗鉢可汗的兄弟達頭可汗另立旗號，與沙摩羅分庭抗禮，汗庭的威令只在於「誰能讓更多部眾跟著走」。開皇三年（583），沙摩羅被自己的部將殺死，汗位由其弟達摩可汗接下；此時汗系分作達摩、達頭、顛頡幾個政治中心，每一個都自稱可汗，各自統著若干部落：達摩據牙帳與陰山以北的牧地，達頭控制金山、准噶爾一帶的部眾，顛頡則以年輕勇銳聚眾於東邊。開皇七年（587），顛頡起兵挑戰達摩，達摩西奔鐵勒而亡；開皇八年（588），顛頡被自己的部下所殺，頗利可汗與沙莫斯（都藍）爭奪汗位，聯盟內部分裂成東、西兩半。真正的第三方是隋朝：開皇元年楊堅受禪稱帝之後，幽州、並州、靈州三邊的總管府與屯田、驛傳構成前沿，隋朝並不與突厥正面交鋒，而是遣使冊封、送馬賜帛、和親拉攏、挑撥各部，必要時再出塞打上一仗，讓內戰替自己減少一個北方大敵。
countriesEn: This war was never a set battle between two lines; every belligerent lay on one side, inside the Turkic confederation itself. In Kaihuang 1 (581) Shabulo Qaghan killed the boy kagan Tokin and seated himself on the throne, drawing the loose northern alliance into a single whip; at the same time Datou Qaghan, brother of the late Tudun, raised a standard of his own and stood as a rival to Shabulo, so that the authority of the khaganate rested on nothing more than who could make more tribes follow him. In Kaihuang 3 (583) Shabulo was killed by his own commanders and the throne passed to his brother Yami. By then the ruling house had split into several political centres — Yami, Datou and the young Qimin — each calling itself kagan and each holding a share of the tribes: Yami the encampment and the pastures north of the Yin mountains, Datou the bands around the Altai and the Dzungarian side, Qimin the younger and fiercer men of the east. In Kaihuang 7 (587) Qimin rose against Yami, who fled west to the Tiele and died; in Kaihuang 8 (588) Qimin was murdered by his own subordinates, and Puli Qaghan and Samo (Tulan) fought over the throne until the alliance fell apart into an eastern and a western half. The real third party was the Sui dynasty. After Yang Jian took the abdication in Kaihuang 1, the frontier commands of Youzhou, Bingzhou and Lingzhou, with their garrisons, farms and post stations, formed the outer line. The Sui never met the Turks in a set battle: they sent envoys to invest khagans, gave horses and silk, cemented ties with marriage, set the rival factions against one another, and struck out of the enclosure again when necessary, letting the civil war do the work of removing a dangerous neighbour of the north.
people: 這場內戰裡做決定的是汗室裡的幾個男人，外加一位坐在長安的皇帝。沙摩羅可汗是佗鉢可汗的叔父，開皇元年他靠牙帳兵馬的實力廢掉幼侄佗斤；佗斤在位五年，幾乎什麼都沒來得及做。達頭可汗是另一位握有重兵的族長，與沙摩羅長期並立，隋朝在兩者之間反覆下注。達摩可汗是沙摩羅的弟弟，開皇三年繼位，起初頗得部眾，開皇五年遣使內屬、被隋冊封為可汗，開皇七年更娶隋文帝之女樂平公主；然而不到一年，他就在姪子顛頡的攻擊下失敗，奔往鐵勒而亡。顛頡可汗是全場最年輕也最致命的一個：他聚兵的速度快過別人的反應，起兵後擊潰達摩、追奔數百里，把叔父的牙帳連根拔起；開皇八年，他的部將卻因賞罰不公與懼怕而反噬，將他殺死，聯盟隨即裂成更小的碎片。頗利可汗在亂後收拾局面，開皇十七年（597）又娶隋文帝之女義成公主；開皇十九年（599）沙莫斯殺頗利，自立為都藍可汗，此後十餘年汗位反覆易手，直到隋朝扶植啟民可汗入主牙帳、唐朝在貞觀年間滅掉東突厥。隋文帝楊堅沒有出現在任何一處戰場，他做的是另一件事：讓兩邊都認為對方是應當打敗的敵人，讓雙方都認為自己才是可以被冊封的可汗。
peopleEn: The decisions in this civil war were taken by a few men of the ruling house, together with one emperor seated at Chang'an. Shabulo Qaghan was the uncle of Tudun; in Kaihuang 1 he used the armed strength of the encampment to set aside his young nephew Tokin, who ruled for five years and had hardly time to do anything at all. Datou Qaghan was another clan leader with troops of his own, standing alongside Shabulo for years, with the Sui repeatedly staking their bets on the rivalry between them. Yami Qaghan, Shabulo's brother, succeeded in Kaihuang 3 and at first held his people well; in Kaihuang 5 he sent an embassy to acknowledge Sui overlordship and was invested as kagan, and in Kaihuang 7 he married Princess Leping, a daughter of Emperor Wen. Within less than a year, however, he was broken by his nephew Qimin and fled west to the Tiele, where he died. Qimin was the youngest and the most lethal figure on the field: he gathered horsemen faster than his enemies could react, and once he rose he broke Yami's army, ran him down for hundreds of li and tore the khagan's encampment up by the roots. In Kaihuang 8 his own commanders turned on him, driven by unfair rewards and by fear, and killed him; the alliance broke into still smaller fragments. Puli Qaghan gathered the pieces afterwards, and in Kaihuang 17 (597) married Princess Yicheng, another daughter of Emperor Wen. In Kaihuang 19 (599) Samo killed Puli and took the throne as Tulan Qaghan, and for more than a decade afterwards the khaganate changed hands repeatedly, until the Sui installed Yimin at the encampment and the Tang destroyed the Eastern Turks in the Zhenguan era. Emperor Wen of Sui never appeared on any battlefield. What he did was something else entirely: he made each side believe the other was the enemy to be beaten, and made each side believe it was itself the kagan whom the Chinese court would invest.
kits: 卡面那具投石機（Onager）在這場戰爭裡沒有出現過，也不會出現：它是羅馬的器械，原理是把絞盤儲存的扭力一次釋放，用單臂甩出石彈。《維特魯威斯建築十書》第十卷留下它最完整的描述，年代已在西元前一世紀，距此時已近八百年；羅馬人後來又把它改成配重式的投石機，地中海世界的攻城戰從此有了可以估算的破壞力。落到 581 年的漠北，這套邏輯完全無用：突厥沒有需要攻破的城牆，也沒有守城需要被砸開的城頭——汗庭是帳幕，不是堡壘；牧地是草場，不是耕地。突厥一方的裝備是另一套：反曲複合角弓配骨鏃、石鏃，射程百五十步上下；皮甲與骨片甲扣在皮襯上；木框蒙皮的圓盾；帶環首的直刃刀與短刀；套在馬上的騎槊、套馬桿；馬鞍、馬鐙、韁繩、馬刺；以及可以在半日之內紮起又拆掉的帳幕與牛車。弓在馬上，帳在牛上，這就是全部。隋朝那邊才是有攻城器械的一方：步槊、拒馬、蹶張弩、發石車、撞車、雲梯、巢車，其中發石車正是投石機在中國的對應物——魏晉以來一直在改良，馬鈞改進的發石車記在《三國志》裡。兩套體系在開皇年間的邊境上主要以互市與冊封的形式接觸，兵戎相見時，草原上仍然是弓與馬的天下。
kitsEn: The onager on this card never appeared in this war, and could not have: it was a Roman machine, working on the principle of releasing in one stroke the torsion stored in a winch and whipping a single arm to throw a stone. Vitruvius's De architectura, in its tenth book, preserves the fullest description of it, and that text already belonged to the first century BC, some eight hundred years before the events here; the Romans then went on to convert the idea into the counterweighted traction trebuchet, and sieges in the Mediterranean world acquired a destructiveness that could be calculated. Dropped into the steppe of 581, that logic is simply useless. The Turks had no city walls to break and no battlements to pound: the khagan's encampment was a tent, not a fortress, and the pasture was grassland, not farmland. The equipment on the Turkic side belonged to a different system altogether: a reflex composite bow of horn and sinew with bone and stone arrowheads, effective to something like one hundred and fifty paces; leather armour and bone-plate armour strapped over a padded jacket; a round shield of wood frame covered with hide; a straight single-edged knife with a ring pommel, and shorter knives; a lance carried on horseback and a pole for catching halters; saddles, stirrups, reins and spurs; and the tents and ox-carts that could be struck and struck again inside half a day. The bow on horseback, the tent on the ox: that is the whole inventory. The side with siege equipment was the Sui, whose train had long spears, caltrops, strong crossbows, stone-throwers, rams, scaling ladders and siege towers; the stone-thrower is the Chinese counterpart of the onager, improved steadily since the Wei and Jin, with Ma Jun's modification of the stone-thrower recorded in the Records of the Three Kingdoms. The two systems touched in the Kaihuang years mainly through trade and investiture; when they did meet in arms, the steppe remained the country of bow and horse.
tactics: 先把可以確定的部分講清楚：史籍沒有留下這場內戰的逐日過程，沒有會戰名稱，沒有陣圖，因此戰術只能從草原戰爭的一般規律與幾個事件痕跡推想。奪汗位在草原上靠的不是儀式上的推舉，而是三件事：一是有多少能騎射的兵馬，二是能不能把別部的部眾從原來的牙帳下挖走，三是有沒有控制水源與冬牧場。顛頡在開皇七年的做法近乎教科書式的草原奪權：他不與達摩在什麼固定的地方解決，而是以游騎遮斷消息、切斷聯絡，把騎隊分成前鋒與兩翼，逼近牙帳所在的牧地，一夜之間以縱隊衝入可汗的營帳；達摩的牙帳被衝破之後，他的部眾不是被「打散」，而是當場換了主人——這正是草原內戰的關鍵：勝者不必消滅敗者，只要把他的人收編過來。追擊是草原戰法的標準動作，潰散之後的追殺往往比會戰本身更慘烈，但史籍在這裡只剩下「奔」「潰」「投」幾個字。另一條戰術線在帳外：隋朝不與任何一方正面結盟，而是冊封、賜物、許以和親，同時挑動對方內部的兄弟叔侄，把突厥的精力消耗在自己的內鬥上；開皇九年、十年，隋朝在突厥大亂之際出塞攻擊，把已經分散的部落趕向更北的地方，順手解除了北方的邊患。兩條線互相配合：草原上的自相殘殺決定了誰來當可汗，隋朝的政策決定了這個可汗願不願意替隋朝看住北邊。
tacticsEn: First the certain part: no day-by-day narrative of this civil war survives, there is no name for a battle and no diagram of a formation, so the tactics can only be inferred from the general rules of steppe warfare and from a few traces of events. Winning the khaganate on the steppe never turned on ritual selection; it turned on three things: how many mounted men one could field, whether one could dig other people's tribes away from the encampment they had been following, and who held the water and the winter pastures. What Qimin did in Kaihuang 7 is close to a textbook steppe seizure of power: instead of meeting Yami on fixed ground, he used his outriders to cut off news and communications, split his horsemen into an advance and two wings, closed on the pastures where the encampment stood, and drove a column into the kagan's tent by night. Once the encampment was broken the men were not so much defeated as transferred: they changed masters on the spot, and that is the key to a steppe civil war — the victor need not destroy the defeated, he only needs to take their men over. The pursuit is the standard movement of steppe war, and the killing after a formation breaks is often worse than the clash itself, yet here the record has only the words for running, breaking and surrendering. The second line of tactics lay outside the tents: the Sui made no frontal alliance with either side but invested khagans, gave gifts, offered marriage, and at the same time worked on the brothers and uncles inside the Turkic house, so that the Turks spent their strength on their own fratricide. In Kaihuang 9 and 10, while the Turks were in confusion, the Sui marched out beyond the frontier and struck, driving the already dispersed bands further north and incidentally lifting the pressure from the northern border. The two lines work together: the mutual slaughter on the steppe decided who would be kagan, and the policy of the Sui decided whether that kagan would hold the northern frontier for the Sui.
data: 這場戰爭留下的數字極少，能寫的只有年表與幾個量級比較。首先是年表：開皇元年（581）沙摩羅弒佗斤，是內戰的開端；開皇三年（583）沙摩羅被殺；開皇五年（585）達摩可汗遣使內屬、被隋冊封；開皇七年（587）達摩娶樂平公主，同年顛頡起兵；開皇八年（588）顛頡被部將所殺；開皇九年（589）前後達頭可汗敗亡；開皇十七年（597）頗利可汗娶義成公主；開皇十九年（599）都藍弒頗利；開皇二十三年（603）汗庭再亂，隋朝扶啟民可汗入主牙帳。數量方面，只有「控弦之士」這類概括說法可以引用：史書形容突厥兵眾以數十萬計，多半是整個聯盟的總量，而不是某一支可以投入野戰的兵團；內戰中實際到場的兵力，沒有任何一部史書給出數字。距離與行程同樣沒有記錄，只有方向：達摩西奔鐵勒是朝西北，隋軍出塞打擊達頭是朝西北與正北。傷亡與俘獲同樣沒有記載，凡有「斬獲」「降者」之說，都是史官對亂局的概括，不能當作可核對的數字。可以確定的只有量級：這是一場以牙帳與部眾為爭奪對象的內戰，參與者是數百部聯盟的首領與他們的騎隊，而不是兩支大軍；它的時間跨度是八年，長到足以把一個聯盟拆成兩半。
dataEn: Very few figures survive from this war, and what can be written down amounts to a chronology and a few comparisons of order of magnitude. The chronology comes first: in Kaihuang 1 (581) Shabulo killed Tokin, which opens the civil war; in Kaihuang 3 (583) Shabulo was killed; in Kaihuang 5 (585) Yami Qaghan sent an embassy to acknowledge Sui overlordship and was invested; in Kaihuang 7 (587) Yami married Princess Leping and Qimin rose in the same year; in Kaihuang 8 (588) Qimin was killed by his own commanders; around Kaihuang 9 (589) Datou Qaghan was destroyed; in Kaihuang 17 (597) Puli Qaghan married Princess Yicheng; in Kaihuang 19 (599) Tulan killed Puli; in Kaihuang 23 (603) the encampment was in confusion again and the Sui installed Qimin (Yimin) there. On numbers, only the general figure of bowmen can be quoted: the histories describe the Turkic host as numbering in the hundreds of thousands, but that is the strength of the whole confederation, not a field army that could be brought into a battle, and not one of them gives the actual force present in this civil war. Distances and marches are equally unrecorded; only directions survive: Yami's flight to the Tiele lay to the north-west, and the Sui expedition against Datou lay to the north-west and due north. Casualties and captures are just as unrecorded, and every statement about heads taken or men surrendered is a chronicler's summary of a confused time rather than a figure that can be checked. What can be asserted with confidence is the order of magnitude: this was a civil war fought over an encampment and over men, between the leaders of hundreds of tribes and their riders, not between two armies; and it ran for eight years, which is long enough to split a confederation in two.
cause: 內戰的起因有四層。最深的一層是汗位繼承的規則壞了：佗鉢可汗在開皇元年之前病逝，留下年幼的兒子佗斤；草原上原本「推立賢能、眾皆賓服」的習慣，被強酋手裡的兵馬打了折扣，殺掉幼主、自立為汗從此成了可以複製的做法。第二層是聯盟本身的鬆散：突厥是由許多大小部落組成的聯盟，牙帳與可汗只是共主，誰能提供保護、誰能分到戰利品，部眾就替誰而戰，於是每一次汗位爭奪都伴隨著大批部眾的改投。第三層是外來力量的介入：隋朝一建立就把北方當作第一要務，幽州、並州、靈州沿線屯田置戍，遣使出塞冊封與勸和，同時刻意讓達摩與達頭、讓沙莫斯與頗利互相猜忌，把草原內部的火點隨時可以點著。第四層是外患與地緣的擠壓：西邊的薩珊波斯在這個時期向高加索與中亞推進，拜占庭也從另一個方向伸手，鐵勒、吐谷渾在西域各有地盤，突厥過去靠劫掠與轉口生意維持的霸權本來就在收縮；內戰一開，誰都沒有餘力去管外邊。
causeEn: The civil war had four layers of cause. The deepest was that the rules of succession had broken down: Tudun Qaghan died before Kaihuang 1 and left a young son in Tokin, and the steppe custom of raising the worthy and being accepted by all was worn thin by the fact that a strong clan leader now held the armed strength; killing a boy kagan and seating oneself in his place became a repeatable method. The second layer was the looseness of the confederation itself. The Turks were a league of many tribes great and small, and the encampment and its kagan were only a first among equals: whichever side offered protection and a share of the plunder would be followed, and so every struggle over the khaganate was accompanied by whole tribes changing allegiance. The third layer was the arrival of outside power. As soon as it was founded the Sui made the north its first concern, established farms and garrisons along Youzhou, Bingzhou and Lingzhou, and sent envoys beyond the frontier to invest khagans and to mediate between them, while deliberately keeping Datou and Yami, and Samo and Puli, suspicious of one another, so that the fire in the steppe could be lit whenever needed. The fourth layer was the pressure of foreign neighbours: to the west the Sasanian empire was pushing into the Caucasus and Central Asia in these years while Byzantium reached out from the other direction, the Tiele and the Tuyuhun each held ground in the western regions, and the hegemony the Turks had lived on through plunder and middleman trade was already shrinking; once the civil war opened, no one had the strength left to look outward.
impact: 內戰的直接後果，是突厥聯盟在開皇年間被劈成兩半。汗位的爭奪打亂了原有的部落分布：西部的部落跟著西邊的牙帳走，東部的跟著東邊的走，開皇末年與大業初年愈演愈烈，最終在開皇二十三年（603）前後正式分立出西突厥，東突厥則在隋朝扶植的啟民可汗與其子始畢可汗手中延續到貞觀初年。這場內戰還改變了北方邊疆的權力結構：鐵勒各部在亂中向北收縮，又陸續南附，終於在唐初以「鐵勒十姓」的名義內屬，成為唐太宗一面用來對付突厥的旗子、一面用來安頓降部的政治資源。對中原而言，內戰的受益者是隋朝：它用冊封與和親把一個本來不斷南下的草原聯盟變成了邊疆的守門人，開皇年間北邊因此相對安定，也才有餘力南下滅陳、經營西域。對草原而言，內戰的代價是致命的：牙帳的權威不再自動維持，誰是「真可汗」要靠兵力一次一次地重新確認，這個習慣一直延續到唐末，草原政權的分分合合幾乎沒有停過。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the civil war was that the Turkic alliance was split in two during the Kaihuang years. The struggle for the khaganate scrambled the old distribution of the tribes: those in the west followed the western encampment, those in the east followed the eastern one, and the process worsened through the last years of Kaihuang and the first years of the Daye era until, around Kaihuang 23 (603), a Western Turkic khaganate stood apart as a separate polity, while the Eastern Turks went on under the Yimin kagan installed by the Sui and then his son Shebi into the Zhenguan era. The civil war also changed the power structure of the northern frontier. The Tiele bands drew northward in the confusion and then came south to submit, ending as the Ten Tribes of the Tiele in the early Tang, a banner to be used against the Turks and a political resource for settling surrendered people. For the Central Plains the beneficiary was the Sui, which used investiture and marriage to turn a confederation that had kept coming south into the gatekeeper of the frontier; the north was comparatively quiet through the Kaihuang years, and that quiet is what left the Sui spare strength to destroy Chen in the south and to work the western regions. For the steppe the price was fatal: the authority of the encampment no longer maintained itself, and who was the true kagan had to be reconfirmed by force again and again, a habit that lasted until the late Tang and left the steppe polities splitting and merging almost without pause.
result: 點到為止：這場內戰沒有真正的勝負手。它以幾次成功的弒君收場——沙摩羅弒佗斤、達摩之眾弒沙摩羅、顛頡之眾弒顛頡、沙莫斯弒頗利——每一次都換了主人，卻沒有換掉草原上「兵馬定一切」的邏輯。可確定的結果有三項：第一，開皇年間的漠北不再是一個能集結全部控弦之眾對付中原的整體，聯盟實質解體；第二，隋朝用外交與出塞打擊兩手漁利，北方邊境壓力大幅下降，北部邊鎮與屯田得以穩定經營；第三，汗位繼承的內耗被帶進了下一個百年，開皇以後的突厥可汗一個接一個短命，東突厥在貞觀二十六年（630）被蘇定方滅掉時，部眾西走、內附，草原政權第一次被中原王朝徹底拆散。真正的贏家是第三方：這場八年的內戰沒有替突厥留下任何可以繼承的秩序，倒是替隋朝清空了北方的隱患，而隋朝又把自己的分裂留給了唐。
resultEn: To sum it up: this civil war had no real decisive battle. It ended in a series of successful murders — Shabulo killing Tokin, Yami's men killing Shabulo, Qimin's men killing Qimin, Samo killing Puli — and each time only the master changed; the steppe logic that armed strength settles everything was never displaced. Three results can be asserted. First, the steppe north of the Kaihuang years was no longer a single whole able to muster all its bowmen against the Central Plains; the alliance had come apart in substance. Second, the Sui profited from two hands at once, diplomacy and the expedition beyond the frontier, the pressure from the north fell sharply, and the northern commands and farms could be run on a settled basis. Third, the waste of a contested succession was carried into the next century: the Turkic khagans after Kaihuang lived short lives one after another, and when the Eastern Turks were destroyed by Su Dingfang in Zhenguan 26 (630) their people went west or submitted, and for the first time a steppe polity was broken up entirely by a Chinese dynasty. The real winner was the third party. Eight years of civil war left the Turks no order worth inheriting, but it cleared the northern danger away for the Sui — and the Sui passed its own divisions on to the Tang.
